digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: Tech, IT, Web Dev, DevOps, Design

stories.headline: Nvidia Nears Massive $12.9B Hugging Face Acquisition
stories.blurb: Nvidia is reportedly in late-stage talks to acquire the open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, a move that would consolidate its grip on the developer ecosystem.

stories.headline: Amazon Triples Nvidia GPU Commitments Amid Insatiable Demand
stories.blurb: AWS is adding 2 million next-gen Blackwell Ultra and Rubin GPUs to its capacity as enterprise interest in Bedrock and SageMaker continues to surge.

stories.headline: Anthropic Signs Colossal $45 Billion Compute Deal with Nscale
stories.blurb: Anthropic has agreed to lease 460 megawatts of capacity at Nscale's West Virginia campus over six years to power its next-generation models with Nvidia Rubin systems.

stories.headline: Meta Outlines Rivalry With Anthropic While Remaining a Key Customer
stories.blurb: Despite Mark Zuckerberg's public criticisms of closed AI labs, internal projections reveal Meta is one of Anthropic’s largest customers, spending up to $10 billion annually on its APIs.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Slashes 1.1.1.1 DNS Cache Memory Usage by 100 Terabytes
stories.blurb: By deploying five structural optimizations to its DNS cache storage, Cloudflare cut its per-entry footprint by 56%, boosting lookup speeds and lowering resident memory across its global network.

stories.headline: Kubernetes v1.37 Released with 67 Performance and Stability Enhancements
stories.blurb: Code-named "Garhwal," the latest release graduates the metrics API and KYAML to stable, activates memory quality of service by default, and introduces concurrent watch object decoding.

stories.headline: Why AI Is Making Massive Codebase Migrations Practical
stories.blurb: Success stories like Asana's two-week framework migration show that AI-assisted tooling can bypass years of traditional engineering overhead to make previously avoided refactoring projects viable.

stories.headline: Palo Alto Networks Eyed Okta and Datadog Prior to CyberArk Pivot
stories.blurb: Cybersecurity giant Palo Alto Networks reportedly engaged in preliminary acquisition discussions with both Okta and Datadog before moving forward with a $25 billion deal for CyberArk.

stories.headline: Anthropic Standardizes Hardware Control Drivers for AI Agents
stories.blurb: Anthropic's new Model Harness Standard streamlines how AI agents interface with laboratory and industrial hardware, drastically reducing the time required to set up automated physical experiments.

stories.headline: Hugging Face Launches Microduck, a $399 Open-Source Robot
stories.blurb: Built with an open-source reinforcement learning stack, this cute 25-centimeter-tall duck-like robot can walk, grip items, and skate, making physical AI robotics research highly accessible.

stories.headline: The Evolving Role of the Product Designer Under AI Collapse
stories.blurb: As AI automates wireframing and prototyping, product designers must transition into "product architects" who prioritize user workflows, systems design, and critical judgment over screen deliverables.

stories.headline: Meta Faces Legal Reckoning Over the Ethics of Infinite Scroll
stories.blurb: State attorneys general are arguing in a federal trial that Meta's endless feed was deliberately engineered to exploit human psychology, threatening the design pattern’s future.

stories.headline: Adobe Integrates Camera Raw Tools Directly Into Photoshop Canvas
stories.blurb: Photoshop's major update introduces non-destructive Light Adjustment Layers alongside Firefly-powered AI markup tools to make complex photo editing far more intuitive.
